instruction: Robert paid for my grocery recently as my payment cards were not working at the time. Send them the owed money with a description note "Thanks for the groceries!" as per my phone text conversation, and then send them a phone text message, "Done. Thanks!".
notes: Two-app task (phone + venmo). Usernames come from supervisor.show_profile (phone uses phone_number, venmo uses email), so both logins require (profile-known) and (passwords-known). phone.search_contacts with query 'Robert' discovers Robert's email and phone number (known-email/known-phone); phone.get_current_date_and_time is required before phone.search_text_messages so yesterday's conversation can be identified and the owed grocery amount parsed (found-owed-amount). venmo.create_transaction sends that amount to Robert's email with the fixed description and sets (paid robert), which gates phone.send_text_message to enforce the 'and then' ordering. The static facts email-of/phone-of/owes/contact-query only associate runtime-valued objects with Robert; their values are unknown until looked up. supervisor.complete_task takes the task-record objects as non-API parameters, requires both goal conditions, and is the only action setting (task-completed); every other action requires (not (task-completed)). No answer is passed since the task is not a question.
